question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A doubtful look or examination of one's motives.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Suspect"** means to have an idea or impression of the existence, presence, or truth of something without certain proof. (संदेह करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police **suspect** that the thief is still in the neighborhood.
 
 
 
• **"A doubtful look or examination of one's motives"** refers to scrutinizing someone's intentions with suspicion. (किसी के उद्देश्यों पर संदेहपूर्ण दृष्टि या परीक्षा)
 
 
• **Example: **She gave him a** suspect **look when he offered to help without any reason.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Suspect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Introspect **(आत्मनिरीक्षण करना): To examine one's own thoughts and feelings.

 
 
• **Example:** After the argument, he took some time to** introspect **and understand his own feelings.
 
 
 
• **Circumspect **(सावधान): Wary and unwilling to take risks.
 
 
• **Example: **He was very **circumspect** in his financial dealings to avoid any losses.
 
 
 
• **Retrospect** (पुनरावलोकन): A review or contemplation of the past.
 
 
• **Example:** In **retrospect**, he realized that his decision was the right one.
 
 

35:Tb92,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
